_about: The capstone's milestones (BP-4.3 §2). A golden run belongs to the highest milestone among its features (M1 when it has none). A feature is found in the golden's tape, board or eval (dotted keys, lists searched item by item; 'text' substrings in the document's JSON) or in its recorded events ('kind' or 'kind.field=<canonical JSON>'). tools/parity.py --assign prints the result.

milestones.M1: the core run: tape, scripted model, board modules of section 7, events, cost (ENGINE.md sections 1 to 11)
milestones.M2: amendments A1 to A3: context overflow, the simulated human, the rulings of building both runtimes
milestones.M3: amendments A4 and A5: incident tapes, and the harness bugs on purpose (history, first block only)
milestones.M4: amendments A6 to A8: compaction, the clock, prompt caching, input checks, split results, effort
milestones.M5: amendments A9 and A10: tool design, tools on demand, tamperable tests, cost attribution
milestones.M6: amendments A11 to A13: evals, prompt injection, tool provenance and pinned servers, canaries
milestones.M7: amendments A14 to A19: sub-agents, sessions, crash and resume, side effects, model profiles, branch pointers, a board's rules

features.description: A1: the prompt is over the window
A2: deny_if and fatigue, and the human field of permission
A3.6: paths outside the workspace (outside)
A3.4: list_files and ls join the paths with newlines and no trailing newline
A3.7: symbolic links in the workspace
A3.8: egress hosts in the sandbox
A3.9 and A3.10: rules[i] naming and glob rules
A3.18: a tool output that the cap cuts
A3.20: redaction of events, not of wire payloads
A3.17: an interrupt with resume: the pending calls never run
A4: an incident block (the hunt's tape)
A5.1 and A5.2: history resend false, history_lt
A5.3: the harness reads the first block only
A6.3: compaction, and its notes
A6.1: context_gte and sent_lacks
A6.4: the system clock (a harness bug on purpose)
A6.5: prompt caching and its cache rules
A7.1: validate_inputs and input_check
A7.2: split results (a harness bug on purpose)
A7.3: effort levels and thinking tokens
A9.1 and A9.2: tool_overrides and tool_search
A9.3: tape tests and pristine tests
A9.4: cost attribution
A11.1 and A11.3: last_result_contains and canaries
A11.4 and A11.5: tool server provenance and tool_pins
A11.7: evals (every eval golden)
A14.1: sub-agents and run_agent
A14.2: sessions and the progress file
A14.3: crash, durable sessions and resume
A14.4: ledgers, lost replies, retries and idempotency
A14.5: model profiles, request params, capability check
A19: a board's rules replace the tape's rules
